name: The Lodhi-Shima-Shi
positioning: The Lodhi, New Delhi: a Kerry Hill-designed city hotel set amid gardens near Humayun's Tomb, with private plunge pools in many rooms and suites and an extensive athletic club
best_for: Travelers who want a room or suite with a private plunge pool in central Delhi
Guests who want serious sports facilities such as tennis, squash and pickleball in the city
Visitors who want easy access to Lodi Gardens, Khan Market and Humayun's Tomb

facts.text: The architecture uses intricate jaali screens, rough and smooth stone, and lofty ceilings.
Contemporary Indian art is curated in partnership with Apparao Galleries.
The hotel is set amid lush gardens and overlooks landmarks such as Humayun's Tomb.
Guests are moments from Lodhi Garden, Khan Market and Humayun's Tomb.
The two-floor Sultan Suite has a personal fitness area, infrared sauna, spa daybed and plunge pool.
Perbacco has a dedicated wine cellar with over 100 labels from various Italian regions.
Safari Lounge showcases a curated collection of wildlife photographs alongside new-age mixology.
Elan takes an ingredient-first approach, working closely with local farmers and producers.
The hotel has three all-weather tennis courts with markers and ball boys on hand.
The hotel has pickleball courts, which it describes as Delhi's first at a luxury hotel.
Yoga can be practised indoors, in the hotel gardens or in the nearby historic Lodi Gardens.
The hotel arranges curated intercity trips to Agra, including the Taj Mahal and Fatehpur Sikri.

highlights.text: The Lodhi Room is the first room category with the hotel's signature private plunge pool.
The Lodhi was designed by architect Kerry Hill.
The Athletic Club includes a temperature-controlled lap pool, squash courts, table tennis, tennis courts, a Pilates studio and hot and cold plunge pools.
The Lodhi Spa houses a Turkish Hammam.
The Lodhi Premier Suites on the 7th and 8th floors have views of the city skyline, Delhi Golf Course and Humayun's Tomb.

considerations.text: Access to the Athletic Club is exclusive to in-house guests and members, so the facilities are shared with club members.
WhataHotel notes the hotel is in South Delhi, so reaching Old Delhi's historic monuments and markets takes some travel time.
WhataHotel notes an ultra-luxury price point among Delhi's most premium hotels.
